description: Shared wire contracts and normalized execution outputs for the ComfyUI backend: prompt, node-error, system-stats, and user-data response types, websocket message and execution-output schemas, result parsing and media classification, and HTTP error payload parsing used by API clients. Job list and detail schemas and the jobs client belong to the job queue; client execution state and authenticated media URLs remain separate.

characterizationScenarios.name: Shared output parsing preserves media and text results across job and live execution consumers
Websocket execution-output schemas accept backend result items and task outputs
HTTP error payloads parse into stable codes and bounded user-facing messages
Annotated result paths round-trip folder type and subfolder

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
Message and response type names stay stable because scripts/api, extension types, and execution, queue, asset, billing, and workspace callers import them.

The api-client executionTypes module is the public entry point for graph-model. Its import of TaskStatus from the tasks record and errors.ts recognizing billing and workspace error shapes remain untracked cross-domain coupling without dependency exceptions.
